auto_leftover_draft.label: Auto-write leftover requirement draft
auto_leftover_draft.help: When on, if this run still has leftovers (test defects, failed cases, review findings/action items, or open clarify questions), create one self-contained requirement draft in the project with the requirement spec and full leftover text; it remains usable after the original workflow is deleted. Off by default.

agent.label: Agent
agent.desc: Run the chosen Agent toward a goal; tools, products, interaction and review come from the Agent's capabilities

prompt.label: Goal
prompt.placeholder: What this step should achieve; reference variables with {'{{vars.feature}}'}

agent.help:
### Agent node (agent)

A node only sets three things: which Agent, the goal and a timeout.

**Capabilities belong to the Agent**: interaction (multi-turn clarify / one autonomous run), post-run human review, granted tools and readable/writable products are declared on the Agent Studio **Capabilities** tab. Every node using the same Agent has the same capabilities; nodes differ only by goal.

**Outlets**: when the Agent writes a verdict product (test result, review verdict) the node has **Pass** and **Fail** outlets; otherwise a single outlet.

**Products**: every product the Agent declares appears in the node outputs (rendered Markdown and raw JSON).

human_gate.help:
### Human gate (human_gate)

Suspends at the orchestrator and appears in the **Pending approvals** inbox. Review the content and pick an action to continue. The same approval UI can also open from run detail.

**Outlets**: each action is one outlet on the node; connect it to the node that action should lead to.

**Display content / primary whitelist**

- `body_template` controls which primary artifacts appear in the gate editor
- Reference with `{'{{nodes.*.outputs.*}}'}` or `artifact("name")`
- **Any artifact humans must edit must be listed in body_template**; other artifacts are not editable
- Non-text primaries (e.g. images) show as read-only tabs and cannot be saved

**Output variable**

- The selected action id is written to the output variable (default `action`) for downstream nodes and branches
